'''Garrett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], Garrett was serving under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Haresh]], who was in turn answering to [[Darth Vowrawn]]. While the battle for [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]&mdash;raged on and [[Darth Baras]]'s assassins [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|coming]] after Vowrawn, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pulled a bold plan by making their base of operations inside a Republic-aligned corporate building. Having secretly infiltrated the building, soldiers like Garrett put on Republic uniforms and made a show in front of the holocameras, so that Republic enemies had no reason so suspect something was awry. The Emperor's Wrath however laughed at Garrett for using an Imperial accent even though he was in cover and killed him out of impatience.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Emperor's Wrath could choose to tell him to give up the annoying act, kill him or play along with Garrett. If you play along with Garrett's act, he will be spared.
